messages:
amanda: quick heads-up — seeing a ~2% spike in token error rate for torchwave-quant-v2 on hosted after the runtime 3.2.0 unpin last night. any deploybot activity or routing changes?

deploybot: Deploybot: auto-fallback activated for small cohort — 3% traffic -> torchwave-quant-v1 in eu-west at 03:12 UTC. no runtime pin in place. (bot note)

sre_tim: checked logs, looks like kvcache misalignment on longseq paths. sample: ```ERROR kv_cache: invalid offset 0x1fe at kv_shard.cc:412```

oleg: can repro locally with longseq. repro command: `./run_canary --model torchwave-quant-v2 --seq 4096 --runtime 3.2.0` — will push a trace shortly.

maya: proposal: soft-pin runtime 3.1.8 for torchwave-quant-v2 in eu-west + ap-south for 2h while runtime team triages kernel. keep a 10% canary on 3.2.0.

amanda: +1. release_czar can you approve a 2h soft-pin window and confirm rollback plan?

release_czar: approved for 2h. rollback plan: if token-error-rate stays >0.5% after 30m, escalate -> full pin; if OOM or perf regressions hit >1%, immediate rollback to 3.1.8 cluster-wide. owners: runtime-team, infra-sre.

deploybot: executing pin command now: `/deploybot pin-runtime --model torchwave-quant-v2 --runtime 3.1.8 --regions eu-west,ap-south --duration 2h --canary 10%`

sre_tim: I'll run the regression suite and perf benches against 3.1.8 and 3.2.0. pinging when I have metrics.

oleg: FYI SDK 3.4 introduced the session keepalive tweak that changes KV cache reuse timing — could be the trigger when combined with runtime 3.2.0. filing a quick note in the SDK thread.

maya: creating eval set `torchwave-longseq-regen` and an alert: token-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m.

amanda: release note blurb I will post: "Soft-pin runtime 3.1.8 for torchwave-quant-v2 in eu-west & ap-south due to kvcache long-sequence regression observed with runtime 3.2.0. Temporary 2h window; owners: runtime-team & infra-sre; canary traffic retained at 10% for ongoing validation."

deploybot: Pin applied successfully at 1789543240 :white_check_mark:

release_czar: monitoring. if metrics look good at +1h we can lift early, otherwise extend and open a hotfix PR for kvcache kernel. opsbot will post a follow-up summary.
